title: Read Reports for a Specific Request

abstract.text: Get a list of reports generated from a specific analytics report request.
An opaque resource ID that uniquely identifies the resource. Obtain the analytics report request resource ID from the `GET-v1-apps-_id_-analyticsReportRequests` response.
Additional fields to include for each analytics reports resource returned by the response.

Filter the returned reports by category. Possible values: -`APP_USAGE`: A string representing the App Usage category. -`APP_STORE_ENGAGEMENT`: A string representing the App Store Engagement category. -`COMMERCE`: A string representing the App Store Commerce category. -`FRAMEWORK_USAGE`: A string representing the Framework Usage category. -`PERFORMANCE`: A string representing the Performance category.
Filter the returned reports by name.
The maximum number of analytics reports resources to return.
